description: BC Wildfire Active Weather Stations and Data is a dataset listed in British Columbia data catalogue (BC Data Catalogue), an open data portal, published or maintained by BC Wildfire Service. This dataset contains point locations for actively reporting BC Wildfire Service (BCWS) weather stations. BCWS operates a network of automated hourly reporting weather stations to support all aspects of fire management. The data are used as input to the Canadian Forest Fire Danger Rating System, as a basis for weather forecasting and for climate monitoring. Coverage: British Columbia. The portal files it under the publisher BC Wildfire Service. Its tags are BCWS, forest fire, weather station, wildfire. It offers 6 resource(s) in CSV, KML, MULTIPLE, ORACLE_SDE, OTHER. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Access Only. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bc-portal.
